conflicts.text: Owner target is far2, king-adjacent Guard, Paladin alongside Ogre, T2, four cards. Shipped files here keep plusDiagFwd2, random Guard square, no Paladin, sideways DeathTouch and no card game. No selected report measures the full target combination.

Dated Oct9 approval wins over earlier residue in same cells: Pieces F8/V8 (far2), J9 (Guard), F13 (Paladin); King powers G12/AI12 (T2). Rules D18 closes hand-size question but does not choose four; current prompt declares four.
Criteria/pa-r1 describe15-letter two-Beast pool. Current code/rules have14-letter one-Beast pool. pa-r1 has no pool stamp. New target also adds Paladin. Do not certify NEW with pa-r1.
SIM-PLAN seeds and early5.05 Archer worth are historical. Pass2 uses lower Rook anchor. Workshop labels Fair through5.0; pool criterion1 allows5.5. These are distinct products, not one threshold.
Cards use carried64 Elo/pawn with about25% calibration uncertainty. Piece passes measure70±11 d3 and92±13 d4. Do not replace card calibration across depths silently.
Use full intervals for pass/fail. No significant rise does not establish no draw drag or equality. Noninferiority margins for global draws and absolute White parity remain unknown.
M1 read-only inventory fails: macbook-pro-2.local does not resolve. Local copied reports are usable; remote-only reports and raw completeness remain unverified. No remote jobs are touched.
deal-c4k, deal-d4k, deal-nosalv2 and ab-guard-drop-any remain pending here. Root reconciles their data. Do not infer completion from queued row, filename or planned count.
